summary: Blueprint 08 (Account, Property Onboarding & Guidance Preferences) tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass — auth gating on /api/hi/account/* (401 on missing token); /overview returns preferences/properties[]/active_property_id/onboarding{complete,steps[4],progress} with auto-created defaults and guaranteed one active property; GET /preferences auto-creates defaults (beginner/medium/balanced/friendly/imperial); PUT /preferences persists valid values and silently drops invalid enums (verified 'sarcastic'/'wild' rejected while prior values retained); properties CRUD works (list, create with first-becomes-active, edit persistence via GET, activate makes it the only active, delete works, blank-name → 400, last-remaining home → 409 conditional check); onboarding/complete flips overview.onboarding.complete=true; Homie chat integration confirmed — after PUT units=metric, POST /hi/chat/conversations/{cid}/message returns a reply mentioning cm/metric (get_guidance_context() is injected). Frontend (mobile 390x844): login → HI dashboard → 'Setup & Preferences' (hi-account) opens the screen; Guidance preferences section renders with all 5 chip groups; tapping pref chips (pref-experience_level-advanced, pref-budget_sensitivity-high, pref-units-metric) highlights them (persisted state after PUT); Your homes list shows ACTIVE tag on current active; add-home flow (home-add → home-name → home-type-House → home-save) creates TEST_UI_<ts> and shows in list; activating another home (home-activate-<id>) moves the ACTIVE tag correctly. Legacy 'Unnamed home' (name=null property) renders correctly with fallback text as expected per main agent note. Cross-feature active-home switching for rooms/assets/projects was intentionally not tested (planned follow-up). Only harmless RN-web warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents, expo-notifications listener on web).
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding_engine.py:_ensure_active_property — sensible: creates a default 'My Home' when none exist, and flags props[0] active if none active. Good.
PUT /preferences silently ignores invalid enum values (design choice). Could return 400 for stricter validation, but current behavior matches spec.
DELETE /properties/{id} returns 409 when it's the last remaining home — clean rule. If deleted home was active, _ensure_active_property re-activates a remaining one.
onboarding.get_guidance_context() returns empty string on error/no prefs — safe fallback; conversation_hub_engine + project_planner_engine both wrap in try/except.

Frontend account/index.tsx swallows all API errors in load()/setPref()/addHome() catch blocks — silent failure UX. Consider surfacing a toast if the overview call fails outright (currently would leave spinner indefinitely).
Overview shape returns preferences dict as-is (no _id leaking because _get_prefs pops it). Verified in tests.

PropertyReq.property_type validation is a no-op — the ternary `req.property_type if req.property_type in PROP_TYPES else req.property_type` collapses to just req.property_type. Not a bug (any string accepted), but the code intent is unclear.
onboarding steps count is hardcoded to 4 — progress rounding math is correct.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ properties created in demo_home@diyhomie.com during tests. One (TEST_Cabin_*) is deleted by test_delete_property. The other (TEST_Spare_*) and a UI-created TEST_UI_<ts> remain — harmless, all prefixed with TEST_. Demo user preferences ended in state: experience_level=advanced, units=metric, budget_sensitivity=high, tone=friendly, risk_tolerance=balanced. Onboarding was marked complete via /onboarding/complete during backend tests, so the frontend progress card is hidden (expected). If main agent wants the progress card visible, flip onboarding_complete=false in hi_user_prefs for the demo user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blueprint 08 is green. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_account_onboarding_b08.py. Demo user has multiple TEST_ properties which the delete/activate tests clean/manage — safe to re-run idempotently. Homie chat endpoint uses {text: ...} (not {message: ...}) at POST /api/hi/chat/conversations/{cid}/message; response is {assistant: {text, ...}}. Cross-feature 'active home' switching for rooms/assets/projects/toolbox is planned but NOT implemented — do not test that until told.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. Initial UI direct-navigation to /home-intel/account returned 403 on /api/hi/account/overview because we hadn't logged in first (no token in secureStorage). Once we logged in through the landing flow and then tapped hi-account, everything worked. Not a bug — expected auth gating.
